title: The Strength of Curiosity
short_teaser: Questions can open doors that answers cannot.
story: Curious people continue learning because they remain open to possibilities. Many discoveries begin with someone asking a simple question. Questions can open doors that answers cannot. Curiosity changes an ordinary fact into an invitation. Instead of stopping at what happened, it asks what else might be true, what assumptions may be incomplete, and what becomes visible when we look again. The lasting importance is simple: curiosity keeps people growing.
impact: Curiosity keeps people growing. Curiosity loosens the grip of assumptions and creates room for better questions. This matters because the lesson is transferable. It can help someone recognize a pattern, make a more thoughtful choice, or see possibility where they previously saw only a problem.
spark_application: What question are you curious about today? Write three questions about something you have been assuming is fixed. Choose the question that opens the most possibility. Afterward, save a short note about what you noticed, what surprised you, or what you may want to revisit.
